execution_context.file_location: Google App Script (cloud function on e-commerce website)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code intercepts payment card information submitted by customers and sends it to an external attacker-controlled domain, enabling payment card data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Intercepting and exfiltrating payment card data is a classic sign of web skimming/magecart-style attacks.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate e-commerce scripts should process payment data securely and never transmit it to unauthorized third-party domains.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate use would be sending payment data to a PCI-compliant payment processor, not an unknown external domain.
key_indicators: Use of Google App Script to handle sensitive data
Outbound network request to attacker-controlled domain

attack_chain.action: Attacker injects malicious Google App Script into e-commerce website backend.
attack_chain.leads_to: Interception of customer payment card data.

attack_chain.action: Malicious script captures payment card data during checkout.
attack_chain.leads_to: Exfiltration of payment card data to attacker.

attack_chain.action: Stolen payment card data is sent to attacker-controlled infrastructure.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker receives and can monetize stolen payment card data.

behavioral_signatures: Google App Script functions making outbound network requests with sensitive payloads
Unexpected POST requests to external domains from e-commerce checkout scripts
file_indicators: Google App Script files with doPost or doGet handlers accessing payment fields
Scripts embedded in e-commerce platforms that are not part of official payment integrations
network_indicators: Outbound HTTPS requests to domains not associated with legitimate payment processors
Unusual traffic from Google App Script endpoints to unknown external servers
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor e-commerce platforms for unauthorized Google App Script integrations, inspect scripts for outbound network requests containing payment data, and alert on POST requests to external domains not associated with legitimate payment processors. Use network monitoring to detect exfiltration attempts from cloud-based scripts.
